name: a BN4 Soul's unison's last frame, the fight's first
why: BN4 unites a Soul as a state of MegaMan's: at the turn's start (0x0800B658) the hand's Soul pseudo-chip becomes his pending form (AI data +0x10), and his family 0x0D (0x080EBA44, BN4_FAMILY_UNITE) plays the unison by its phases, its last on the fight's clock; BN6 crosses before the fight (the crossing's phases, BN6_CROSSING_PHASES at 0x08014A82, run in the battle's phase before the fight's timer counts). So at the frame BN4's MegaMan is in state 0x0D his object, AI data and collision data, his pending form, the unison's effect (its phase 1's 0x080E18EE), the run order and his panel are the unison's; and its three sounds (0x129 its phase 0's, 0x080EBABE; 0x157 its picture's, 0x080E369A; 0x158 its phase 1's, 0x080EBB32), begun before the fight, are said at the frame after it, where BN6's crossing's were begun before the trace
evidence: bn4_soul_thun: BN4's MegaMan in state 0x0D at t1 alone, his ready state 6 from t2; BN6's in his ready state 8 from t1; BN4's sounds 0x129, 0x157 and 0x158 at t2

name: a Soul's object spawned as he takes the form, each engine's own moment of it

BN6 runs its copy as he enters the proxy form (src/emu/soullife.c, soulbn4_enter_copy), which BN6's crossing ends nearer the fight, so its object (the dispatch's 0xA4) is still in play at the fight's first frames. Read as the same state where BN6's is in play and BN4's is not: its being in play and its place in the run order; and MegaMan's word of the regions he met (BN6_COLL_MET, BN4's +0x4C) where BN6's holds the bit of the hit area the object lays as it ends, which BN4's met before the fight, and no bit BN4's has is missing
evidence: bn4_soul_srch: BN6's object in play t1-t3, BN4's in no fight frame ; MegaMan's +0x6B 0x20 in BN6 at t3, its hit area met (traces of 22 November 2026)

name: a Soul's companion, BN4's own object and BN6's companion overlay of BN4's Souls' kind
why: BN4 spawns NumSoul's (and FireSoul's) companion at the unison and as the Soul ends (BN4_SOUL_COMPANION 0x0800B7E8): its first-kind 0x57 (0x080CC5F4), its word BN4_FORM_COMPANIONS' by form (its sprite's list offset and number), kept at his AI +0x48, its update (0x080CC46E) his animation and place each frame. Read as the same state: its type, its word (BN6's the kind SOUL_OVERLAY_BN4 and 0, his palette, against BN4's list offset and number), its flags' 0x04 (both spawns set it; BN4's init clears it where the battle has appeared, 0x080CC438-0x080CC43E, BN6's overlay keeps it), its sprite's tile place (the renderer's, given in the order things are drawn), BN4's mode 8 (drawn) where BN6's overlay has no mode, BN6's masks (+0x54), its sprite's words by their offsets into the same bytes (the set-ups' CRC32 alike: BN4's list 4 sprite, BN6's copy in the shared look room at list 0's SOUL_LIST0_BN4_COMPANION); and MegaMan's keeping of it, BN6's at his +0x50 and BN4's at his AI +0x48 (the trace's leftovers), each naming the companion

BN6's runner and held routine are the same code (BN6 0x0801B4AA, 0x08016BFC, the same bytes), but BN6 crosses before the fight, its time never stopped in the fight's frames, so its actors keep their +0x30 and +0x32 as they began. Read so after BN4's unison: an actor's +0x18 4 at the unison's frame where BN6's is as it began, and its +0x30 to +0x33 BN4's copies of its own +0x36 to +0x39 where BN6's are as they began The copy is kept after time runs again, so +0x30-+0x33 are held to +0x36-+0x39 as they are or as they were on BN4's last frame of the unison: a push changes its +0x36 later (GutsSoul's punch pushes the Mettaur back, BN4's +0x30 staying the 0x14 its held routine copied, 0x080104E6 again by romlab's write watch on bn4_soul_guts)
